editorial:
Step behind the scenes of a galaxy far, far away as Ewan McGregor and Hayden Christensen suit up once more. This documentary takes you into the making of Obi-Wan Kenobi, showing how the cast and crew brought back beloved characters while building new heroes and villains. You get a close look at the excitement, pressure, and heart that went into bridging the gap between the prequels and the original trilogy. It feels like a warm reunion for fans, with plenty of laughs, tears, and surprises along the way. You will love seeing old friends reconnect on set.

The best parts are the honest interviews and the raw footage of lightsaber training and set building. You see Deborah Chow guiding everyone with calm focus, and the actors clearly loving every minute. On the downside, some moments feel a little promotional, and you might wish for more time with certain characters. Still, if you grew up with Star Wars, this is a must-watch.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you see the cast wrap filming and share emotional goodbyes. Ewan and Hayden reflect on what these roles mean to them after so many years. The last moments show a surprise reunion that ties the whole story together, reminding you why these characters matter. You leave feeling hopeful and nostalgic, with a clear sense that the saga still has plenty of life left in it.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Star Wars and behind-the-scenes stories.
